title: Zephyr: Destination Unreachable
close_reason: Implemented RFC 4443 Destination Unreachable codes 0-6, exact 1232-byte quote bound, canonical wire/checksum generation, address/link-layer/congestion/ICMP-error suppression, extension-header-safe fail-closed handling, and no-partial-output errors. Standalone C, clang-tidy, cppcheck, Python/Rust reference checks, and Zephyr qemu_x86 25/25 pass. native_sim is unavailable locally because Zephyr POSIX requires Linux.
